div.head: Wl art retr 11.1
div.ab: Et ideo castella et burgi et ciuitates sunt et fundate et edificate, scilicet ad tuitionem gentium et populorum regni et ad defensionem regni, et iccirco obseruari debent cum omni libertate et integritate et ratione.

Et ideo castella et burgi et civitates sitae sunt et fundatae et aedificatae, scilicet ad tuitionem gentium et populorum regni et ad defensionem regni, et idcirco observari debent cum omni libertate et integritate et ratione.

And for this purpose castles, boroughs and cities have been founded and established, namely, for the protection of the races and peoples of the realm and for the defence of the realm, and therefore they should be maintained in full liberty and independence and with the best possible organisation.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 248–249 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text added from Gesetze I p. 491, October 2026 (two independent readings of the page images)
